top_signals.title: European Stocks Set for Record as Energy, Tech Gain
top_signals.summary: European stocks climbed toward a fresh record, as energy shares rallied alongside gains in tech and miners, boosting sentiment.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Stocks Rise as CoreWeave Outlook, Anthropic Revive AI Trade
top_signals.summary: US stocks opened higher Wednesday after better-than-expected results from CoreWeave Inc., investor enthusiasm for Anthropic PBC’s IPO, and a blockbuster quarter for OpenAI are reviving the artificial intelligence trade.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Texas trucking owner indicted in scheme involving 57 unauthorized drivers
top_signals.summary:
A Laredo trucking company owner faces federal charges for allegedly employing 57 unauthorized B-1 visa drivers to haul domestic freight across the U.S.
